RemediationStrings.Title: Device attestation required
RemediationStrings.Description: This device must complete LTZ thin attestor verification. Contact Linux platform.

RemediationStrings.Title: Attestation ticket expired
RemediationStrings.Description: Renew device attestation (ltz-trust-agent). Ticket must be unexpired.

RemediationStrings.Title: Disk encryption required
RemediationStrings.Description: Host must use LUKS (preferably TPM-bound). Contact Linux platform for baseline remediation.
